goal_vi: Học sinh có thể nói về bản thân và bạn bè, mô tả những gì bạn bè làm cùng nhau, và bày tỏ cảm xúc về tình bạn.

grammar.title: Present Simple: Actions with friends
grammar.explain_en: We use the present simple to talk about things we usually do with our friends.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì hiện tại đơn để nói về những điều chúng ta thường làm với bạn bè.
examples: I play with my friends every day.
My friend helps me with my homework.
We always laugh together.

grammar.title: Present Continuous: What friends are doing now
grammar.explain_en: We use the present continuous to talk about actions happening right now.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì hiện tại tiếp diễn để nói về các hành động đang xảy ra ngay bây giờ.
examples: My friend is drawing a picture now.
We are talking about our day.
They are laughing loudly.
grammar.right: ✅ My friends are playing in the park.
grammar.wrong: ❌ My friends play in the park now.

grammar.title: Can / Can't: Abilities of friends
grammar.explain_en: We use 'can' to say what someone is able to do, and 'can't' for what they are not able to do.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'can' để nói ai đó có thể làm gì, và 'can't' để nói họ không thể làm gì.
examples: My friend can sing well.
I can't swim very fast.
Can you help me?

grammar.title: Have got / Has got: Describing friends
grammar.explain_en: We use 'have got' or 'has got' to talk about what someone owns or to describe their appearance.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'have got' hoặc 'has got' để nói về những gì ai đó sở hữu hoặc mô tả ngoại hình của họ.
examples: I have got a new friend.
She has got long black hair.
They have got many interesting books.
grammar.right: ✅ My friend has got a big smile.
grammar.wrong: ❌ My friend have got a big smile.

readings.title: My Best Friend, Linh
readings.text: My name is Mai. I am eight years old. I have a best friend. Her name is Linh. Linh is eight years old too. She has got short black hair and a happy smile. Linh is very kind. She always shares her toys with me. We play together every day after school. We like to draw pictures and tell stories. Linh can run very fast! I can't run as fast as her, but she always waits for me. We laugh a lot. I feel so happy with Linh. She is my best friend!

readings.title: Our Friendship Garden
readings.text: My name is Nam. I have many friends at school. We are like a big family. Every Tuesday, we meet in the school garden. It's our special 'Friendship Garden.' We are not just playing; we are working together! Today, my friend Minh is watering the flowers. He is very careful. My friend An is picking up fallen leaves. She is always helpful. I am digging a small hole for a new plant. We are laughing and talking while we work. Sometimes, we sing songs. We all help each other. If someone needs help, we always ask, 'Can I help you?' We make the garden beautiful. We learn to be caring and responsible friends. Our friendship is growing, just like the plants in our garden.

readings.title: The New Kid, Ben
readings.text:
This is a story about a new student, Ben. Ben moved to our town last week. He felt a little shy on his first day at Green Primary School. During playtime, he sat alone under a big tree. My friends, Hoa and Duc, and I saw him. We talked about it. Hoa said, 'He looks lonely. We should invite him to play.' Duc agreed, 'Yes, being new can be hard.'
So, we walked over to Ben. I smiled and said, 'Hi, Ben! My name is Mai. Do you want to play soccer with us?' Ben looked up, surprised. He smiled back and said, 'Yes, please!' He was a bit quiet at first, but he tried his best to play. He wasn't very good at soccer, but he was very brave because he kept trying. We didn't care if he was perfect; we just wanted him to feel welcome. After playing, we sat and talked. Ben told us about his old school and his favorite games. We learned that he is very honest and also very funny! Now, Ben is not shy anymore. He plays with us every day. We are happy because we have a new friend, and Ben is happy because he has new friends. Friendship makes everyone happy!

listening.script: Hello everyone! Today, I want to talk about my friends. I have three best friends: An, Hoa, and Minh. An is a girl with long, curly hair. She is very energetic and always laughing. She loves to play tag in the park. Hoa is a quiet girl, but she is very thoughtful. She always listens carefully when I talk. She has got pretty glasses. Minh is a boy, and he is very brave. He is good at climbing trees! All my friends are very kind. We often meet after school. We are usually playing games, but sometimes we just sit and talk about our day. Right now, An and Minh are playing soccer, and Hoa is reading a book. I feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends. They make me happy every day!

life_skill.title: BE A GOOD FRIEND
life_skill.intro: Friendship is a wonderful gift! To have good friends, we also need to be good friends. Here are some ways to be a good friend:
life_skill.intro_vi: Tình bạn là một món quà tuyệt vời! Để có những người bạn tốt, chúng ta cũng cần phải là những người bạn tốt. Dưới đây là một số cách để trở thành một người bạn tốt:
can_do: I can listen to my friends.
I can be kind and polite.
I can celebrate my friends' successes.
I can always be there for my friends.
life_skill.value_question: What is one thing you can do today to be a better friend?
life_skill.image_prompt: A group of diverse 8-year-old Vietnamese children showing various acts of kindness and friendship: one sharing a toy, one helping another up, two listening to each other, all smiling in a warm, inviting setting.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The longest friendship recorded lasted over 90 years!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Tình bạn dài nhất được ghi nhận kéo dài hơn 90 năm!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Having friends can make you feel happier and healthier.
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Có bạn bè có thể khiến bạn cảm thấy vui vẻ và khỏe mạnh hơn.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Animals can also have best friends, just like humans!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Động vật cũng có thể có bạn thân, giống như con người!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Smiling is contagious! When you smile, your friends are more likely to smile back.
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Nụ cười có tính lây lan! Khi bạn cười, bạn bè của bạn cũng có nhiều khả năng cười lại.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Good friends celebrate your victories and comfort you when you are sad.
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Những người bạn tốt sẽ ăn mừng chiến thắng của bạn và an ủi bạn khi bạn buồn.

classroom_game.name: Friendship Web
steps_en: The teacher stands in the middle of the circle, holding a ball of yarn.
The teacher says, "My friend [Name] is kind." and holds onto the end of the yarn, then gently throws the ball to that friend.
The friend catches the yarn, says, "My friend [Another Name] can run fast," holds onto the yarn, and throws it to the next friend.
Continue until everyone has held the yarn and said something about a friend. A "friendship web" will form!
When finished, talk about how everyone is connected.
steps_vi: Giáo viên đứng giữa vòng tròn, cầm một cuộn len.
Giáo viên nói, "Bạn [Tên] của em rất tốt bụng." và giữ lấy đầu sợi len, sau đó nhẹ nhàng ném cuộn len cho bạn đó.
Bạn đó bắt lấy len, nói, "Bạn [Tên khác] của em có thể chạy nhanh.", giữ lấy sợi len, và ném cho bạn tiếp theo.
Tiếp tục cho đến khi mọi người đều đã cầm sợi len và nói điều gì đó về một người bạn. Một "mạng lưới tình bạn" sẽ hình thành!
Khi kết thúc, hãy nói về cách mọi người được kết nối với nhau.
